text: A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O Jehovah,{H3068} do I lift up{H5375} my soul.{H5315}
O my God,{H430} in thee have I trusted,{H982} Let me not be put to shame;{H954} Let not mine enemies{H341} triumph{H5970} over me.
Yea, none that wait{H6960} for thee shall be put to shame:{H954} They shall be put to shame{H954} that deal treacherously{H898} without cause.{H7387}
Show{H3045} me thy ways,{H1870} O Jehovah;{H3068} Teach{H3925} me thy paths.{H734}
Guide{H1869} me in thy truth,{H571} and teach{H3925} me; For thou art the God{H430} of my salvation;{H3468} For thee do I wait{H6960} all the day.{H3117}
Remember,{H2142} O Jehovah,{H3068} thy tender mercies{H7356} and thy lovingkindness;{H2617} For they have been ever of old.{H5769}
Remember{H2142} not the sins{H2403} of my youth,{H5271} nor my transgressions:{H6588} According to thy lovingkindness{H2617} remember{H2142} thou me, For thy goodness'{H2898} sake, O Jehovah.{H3068}
Good{H2896} and upright{H3477} is Jehovah:{H3068} Therefore will he instruct{H3384} sinners{H2400} in the way.{H1870}
The meek{H6035} will he guide{H1869} in justice;{H4941} And the meek{H6035} will he teach{H3925} his way.{H1870}
All the paths{H734} of Jehovah{H3068} are lovingkindness{H2617} and truth{H571} Unto such as keep{H5341} his covenant{H1285} and his testimonies.{H5713}
For thy name's{H8034} sake, O Jehovah,{H3068} Pardon{H5545} mine iniquity,{H5771} for it is great.{H7227}
What man{H376} is he that feareth{H3373} Jehovah?{H3068} Him shall he instruct{H3384} in the way{H1870} that he shall choose.{H977}
His soul{H5315} shall dwell{H3885} at ease;{H2896} And his seed{H2233} shall inherit{H3423} the land.{H776}
The friendship{H5475} of Jehovah{H3068} is with them that fear{H3373} him; And he will show{H3045} them his covenant.{H1285}
Mine eyes{H5869} are ever{H8548} toward Jehovah;{H3068} For he will pluck{H3318} my feet{H7272} out of the net.{H7568}
Turn{H6437} thee unto me, and have mercy{H2603} upon me; For I am desolate{H3173} and afflicted.{H6041}
The troubles{H6869} of my heart{H3824} are enlarged:{H7337} Oh bring thou me out{H3318} of my distresses.{H4691}
Consider{H7200} mine affliction{H6040} and my travail;{H5999} And forgive{H5375} all my sins.{H2403}
Consider{H7200} mine enemies,{H341} for they are many;{H7231} And they hate{H8130} me with cruel{H2555} hatred.{H8135}
Oh keep{H8104} my soul,{H5315} and deliver{H5337} me: Let me not be put to shame,{H954} for I take refuge{H2620} in thee.
Let integrity{H8537} and uprightness{H3476} preserve{H5341} me, For I wait{H6960} for thee.
Redeem{H6299} Israel,{H3478} O God,{H430} Out all of his troubles.{H6869}
